lines.t: Yeah…
Shedding this skin…
Death to the pride inside…
Open your eyes…
Only when I shed this skin of the world, do my eyes come alive,
When the death of my pride hits deep, I finally see past the lies.
There’s a Truth on the hill, standing bright in the sky,
Absolute, never moved, unbreakable, high.
Open your eyes, yeah, open your eyes,
Let the old self fall, let the dead man die.
I was wrapped in this flesh, in the weight of my sin,
Chasing dust in the wind, never letting Him in.
But He called me to die to the man I had been,
Tear the grip of this world, peel it off like skin.
All the ego, all the flex, all the false disguise,
Had to lay it in the grave just to truly rise.
When the pride hit the floor and the mask went away,
I saw Truth on that hill, like the break of day.
I can’t see clear with this world in my eyes,
So He said, “Let it go, let your arrogance die.”
When I fall to my knees, when I lay down my life,
Then the veil gets torn and the darkness divides.
Only when I shed this skin of the world, do my eyes come alive,
When the death of my pride hits deep, I finally see past the lies.
There’s a Truth on the hill, standing bright in the sky,
Absolute, never moved, unbreakable, high.
Open your eyes, yeah, open your eyes,
Let the old self fall, let the dead man die.
On a hill, bright and shining, where the fire don’t fade,
Where the word never bends and the rock never breaks.
Every chain that I wore started cracking in two,
When I looked from myself and I stared at the Truth.
No opinion, no trend, no earthly throne,
Just a King on the hill, and His light alone.
Immovable, unshaken, His promise won’t fail,
When the world turns to dust, He’s the one that prevails.
So I cast off the weight, every counterfeit crown,
Every glory of the flesh had to all burn down.
In the death of my pride, in the loss of my life,
I awakened to the One who is shining so bright.
Only when I shed this skin of the world, do my eyes come alive,
When the death of my pride hits deep, I finally see past the lies.
There’s a Truth on the hill, standing bright in the sky,
Absolute, never moved, unbreakable, high.
Open your eyes, yeah, open your eyes,
Let the old self fall, let the dead man die.
Immovable, unbreakable, fire in the night,
Standing on the hill, He’s the only light.
When I lose my life, then I truly find,
Sight for the blind, peace for the mind.
No more chains from the world I’m in,
I step out of the grave, leave the weight of my skin.
Only when I shed this skin of the world, do my eyes come alive,
When the death of my pride hits deep, I finally see past the lies.
There’s a Truth on the hill, standing bright in the sky,
Absolute, never moved, unbreakable, high.
Open your eyes, yeah, open your eyes,
Let the old self fall, let the dead man die.
Open your eyes… open your eyes…
